description:
Ask a question. Get one sentence back. That's the whole app.

Nimble skips the browser, the tabs, the cookie banners and the pile of blue links. Type what you want to know and the answer appears, with its source named underneath.

It works out what kind of question you asked and answers accordingly:

MATH AND UNITS, INSTANTLY AND OFFLINE
Arithmetic, powers, roots, trig, logarithms, percentages and unit conversion, all evaluated on your device. Works on a plane.

FACTS, CHECKED AGAINST LIVE SOURCES
Who holds office today, dates, distances, capitals, populations. Two open models answer side by side, grounded in live Wikipedia, cross-checked against DuckDuckGo. Every answer names its source.

WEBSITES
Ask "what's primitive.dev?" and Nimble reads the site itself and tells you what it does.

CARDS
Weather, local time, currency and word origins come back as a card you can read at a glance.

GRAPHS
Type y = x^2 or plot sin(x) and get the curve, drawn on device.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
No account, no telemetry. Before any question goes to an AI service you are asked once, and you can say no: answers then come from DuckDuckGo and Wikipedia only. Bring your own key for Claude, OpenAI or a local model if you prefer. Your recent searches sync between iPhone and Mac through iCloud, and nothing else leaves the device.

Meet Flit, the hummingbird who hums while your answer loads. Light and dark follow the system. Ask out loud with the mic. English, French, Spanish, Chinese and Punjabi.
promotionalText: Type the question, read the answer. Websites, facts, math, units and graphs, one sentence each, with the source.
